name: silvershop-suite/reviews
description: Reviews with star ratings, moderation and aggregate rating (JSON-LD) for SilverStripe. Works on any site for company/website reviews; product reviews, verified purchases and order-triggered invitations light up when silvershop/core is present.

suggest.silvershop/core: Enables product reviews, verified-purchase badges and order-triggered invitation emails; the module does company/website reviews (on SiteConfig) without it.
suggest.silvershop-suite/store-profile: Shared shop identity used as the sender for review-invitation emails (v2).
suggest.silverstripe/queuedjobs: Scheduled review-invitation emails after an order is fulfilled (v2).
suggest.silverstripe/spamprotection: Pluggable spam protection (reCAPTCHA/hCaptcha/...) auto-enabled on the public forms.
suggest.silvershop-suite/search: Adds a star-rating facet to the storefront product search (requires silvershop/core).
